summary: Iter 49 — Phase 5 Wellness Journey (longitudinal session memory). Verified backend endpoints, prune-to-30, auth gating, agent chat with journey prompt injection, and — most importantly — the Dashboard.jsx play→stop auto-log integration. 7/7 backend pytest, all frontend checks pass including the E2E flow.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx (2121 lines) and AccountDashboard.jsx (1130 lines) both exceed the 700-line guideline — recommend splitting into feature modules in a future refactor (not blocking this phase).
logJourneyEntry useCallback deps list omits `activeSoundscape` in its dep-array despite it being referenced (line 388 — actually it IS listed, false alarm on re-read).
_time_of_day_label uses UTC hour — will show 'morning' at 3 AM local for users in APAC. Fine for MVP; when timezones ship, thread user tz through the log endpoint.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests seed 32 entries on a fresh registered TEST_journey_* user to verify pruning; those rows live on that throwaway user only. Admin user gained ~4 rows across curl-seeded + new test-driven inserts (Freeform 90s, full-payload 432Hz+anxious, E2E 528Hz 68s ended_early).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 5 (My Journey) fully green. Backend endpoints: POST /api/me/journey/log (rejects <60s, prunes to 30, strips ambient=0 channels, sets time_of_day), GET /api/me/journey (newest-first). Frontend: MyJourneySection renders correctly (label 'MY JOURNEY', my-journey-count, per-row testids, tag chips early/assistant, italic mood, toggle appears only when >8 rows). E2E confirmed: Dashboard play→wait 68s→stop resulted in a NEW row {frequency:528, duration_actual_seconds:68, duration_planned_seconds:900, ended_early:true, agent_initiated:false, time_of_day:'morning'} — proves logJourneyEntry POST works end-to-end. Agent chat 200s with {message,suggestions} when journey rows present (WELLNESS_JOURNEY block silently injected, no lookup errors in backend logs). AI Assistant sheet auto-opens on login and BLOCKS play-pause-button clicks — must dismiss via [data-testid='ai-agent-close'] (Escape does not close it in this build); flag for next agent.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs surfaced. First E2E attempt returned 'no new row' but RCA showed the AI Assistant modal (z-60) was intercepting play-pause clicks; using [data-testid='ai-agent-close'] to dismiss unblocked the flow and the row was logged as expected.
